brief: Subtle and generous corner rounding at the right opening of both user-selected C marks. Preserve their circle and commit-line structures.

concepts.name: Split · subtle
concepts.idea: Small rounding on the pointed opening.
concepts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / logo-brand. Edit ONLY the corners around the right-facing opening of the attached Codealong C logo. Preserve the exact design, proportions, circular outer contour and circular inner center, position of the horizontal commit line, and overall visual weight. Keep the mark geometrically constructed and horizontally symmetric. The change should be obvious when compared with the reference but must not alter the idea or close the C. Smooth tangent circular fillets, no lumpy freeform curves. One isolated logo centered on a pure white square canvas at approximately 70% canvas height. No text, labels, mockups, shadows, gradients, texture, bevels, 3D, double outlines or extra decorative details.

Reference: the thin black OUTLINE C with white interiors, a circular white center and a narrow white horizontal cut through the left side. Preserve that outline-only treatment: a single crisp thin black contour and white fill. Preserve the left through-line completely. On the right, replace the two sharp outer arrow-like terminal tips with small round fillets, radius about 4% of the outer diameter. Also gently round the two little inner shoulder corners where the horizontal center neck meets the diagonal opening, using a 2% radius. Retain a substantial straight diagonal segment along both terminal faces. Everything else unchanged. No solid black node and no filled-in C.

concepts.idea: A gentle radius on the outer tips.

Reference: the SOLID BLACK C with a separate solid black circular commit node at its center and a short rightward horizontal stem. Preserve the black fill, white circular negative-space moat, node size, node/stem position, and already rounded inner terminal shoulders. Change only the sharp outer points at the upper-right and lower-right ends of the C: replace those two corner points with gentle rounded fillets, radius about 4% of the outer diameter. Keep most of each 45-degree terminal face straight. Round the two corners at the end of the central horizontal stem only very slightly, preserving its essentially flat end and its length. Exactly the same mark with its sharp opening tips softened.

Reference: the SOLID BLACK C with a separate solid black circular commit node at its center and a short rightward horizontal stem. Round the two pointed outer corners on the upper-right and lower-right terminals more generously, radius about 8% of outer diameter.
